title: Giraffe with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x="42" y="38" width="18" height="38" rx="8" fill="#f2b632"/>
  <!-- neck spots -->
  <ellipse cx="47" cy="47" rx="3.5" ry="4" fill="#b5651d"/>
  <ellipse cx="55" cy="55" rx="3" ry="3.5" fill="#b5651d"/>
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="62" rx="3" ry="3.5" fill="#b5651d"/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="80" rx="22" ry="13" fill="#f2b632"/>
  <!-- body spots -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="77" rx="3.5" ry="3" fill="#b5651d"/>
  <ellipse cx="55" cy="84" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#b5651d"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="77" rx="3" ry="2.8" fill="#b5651d"/>
  <ellipse cx="44" cy="84" rx="3" ry="2.5" fill="#b5651d"/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x="36" y="88" width="6" height="10" rx="2.5" fill="#d99a2b"/>
  <rect x="46" y="89" width="6" height="10" rx="2.5" fill="#f2b632"/>
  <rect x="56" y="88" width="6" height="10" rx="2.5" fill="#d99a2b"/>
  <rect x="64" y="89" width="6" height="10" rx="2.5" fill="#f2b632"/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x="36" y="95" width="6" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#8a5a1a"/>
  <rect x="46" y="96" width="6" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#8a5a1a"/>
  <rect x="56" y="95" width="6" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#8a5a1a"/>
  <rect x="64" y="96" width="6" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#8a5a1a"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="51" cy="28" rx="15" ry="12" fill="#f2b632"/>
  <!-- ossicones (horns) -->
  <rect x="44" y="12" width="3" height="8" rx="1.5" fill="#d99a2b"/>
  <circle cx="45.5" cy="11" r="4" fill="#b5651d"/>
  <rect x="55" y="12" width="3" height="8" rx="1.5" fill="#d99a2b"/>
  <circle cx="56.5" cy="11" r="4" fill="#b5651d"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="24" rx="6" ry="3.5" fill="#e8a82a" transform="rotate(-25 36 24)"/>
  <ellipse cx="66" cy="24" rx="6" ry="3.5" fill="#e8a82a" transform="rotate(25 66 24)"/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx="51" cy="34" rx="9" ry="6" fill="#f7d07a"/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="34" rx="1.3" ry="1.6" fill="#c98a2a"/>
  <ellipse cx="54" cy="34" rx="1.3" ry="1.6" fill="#c98a2a"/>
  <!-- eyes: sparkly -->
  <circle cx="44" cy="25" r="4.5" fill="#3a2a1a"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="25" r="4.5" fill="#3a2a1a"/>
  <!-- sparkle highlights -->
  <circle cx="42.5" cy="23.5" r="1.8" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="56.5" cy="23.5" r="1.8" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="45.5" cy="26.5" r="0.9" fill="#ffe9a8"/>
  <circle cx="59.5" cy="26.5" r="0.9" fill="#ffe9a8"/>
  <!-- extra sparkle stars -->
  <path d="M41 20 l0.6 1.6 1.7 0.2 -1.3 1.1 0.4 1.7 -1.4 -1 -1.4 1 0.4 -1.7 -1.3 -1.1 1.7 -0.2z" fill="#fff9c4"/>
  <path d="M61 20 l0.6 1.6 1.7 0.2 -1.3 1.1 0.4 1.7 -1.4 -1 -1.4 1 0.4 -1.7 -1.3 -1.1 1.7 -0.2z" fill="#fff9c4"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M47 37 q4 3 8 0" stroke="#c98a2a" stroke-width="1.4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d="M70 76 q8 -2 7 -8" stroke="#d99a2b" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="77" cy="67" r="3" fill="#b5651d"/>
</svg>
